contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTAN [---] ; R/ VICTORIAE DD AV[GGQ NN]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Constans (333-350), two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Trier mint, probably RIC vol. 8 page 151 no. 188. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate, large eye, possibly draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN [---]. Reverse description: Two Victories standing facing each other holding wreaths aloft; a star between Victories.…
